children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on October 22, following a slew of corporate developments, and earnings.

Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services share price fell 6 percent despite company reported a 54.8 percent year-on-year surge in standalone profit to Rs 881.5 crore, while net interest income increased 13.2 percent to Rs 2,391.4 crore.

Shares of KEI Industries share price declined 9 percent despite company reported a 29 percent year-on-year jump in consolidated profit to Rs 262.5 crore, while revenue surged 38.5 percent to Rs 3,776.4 crore.

Share price of Indian Hotels Company rose 2 percent after the company reported a 19.4 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated profit to Rs 380 crore, while revenue grew 21.7 percent to Rs 2,484.3 crore.
PC Jeweller shares added 2 percent after the company reported a 58 percent year-on-year surge in consolidated profit to Rs 331.1 crore, while revenue increased 27.8 percent to Rs 1,054.5 crore.

Bharat Electronics share price shed 2 percent even company secured additional orders worth Rs 1,011 crore since October 13. The orders include low-level light-weight radar, communication equipment, sonar, jammers, upgrades, spares and services.

Zydus Lifesciences share price fell 1 percent after group company Zylidac Bio partnered with biotechnology company Prolific Machines to scale Prolific's platform from early-stage development through good manufacturing practice (GMP) production.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: M&M Financial Services, KEI Industries fall 6-9% post Q2 results; PC Jeweller gains as profit surges
